name: Sonus
author: fredde
description: Sonar-style volume mixer for PipeWire: Master, Game, Chat, Media and Aux channels, drag-and-drop app routing, and a 10-band equalizer per category.

barWidget.description: Sonar-style mixer in a bar panel: channel faders, app routing and per-category EQ. Scroll for master volume, middle-click to mute, right-click for settings.
